messages.text: BL-1696 🎵 in progress — `seat` gives a local aider seat its whole command vocabulary: a short verb with fixed arguments for each step a parcel needs (next, done, ask, merge, test, handoff, note), each verb runs exactly one pipeline script or git subcommand, the verbs are allow-listed per role, and any malformed argument is refused before anything runs
